prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

- home: 85.8%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Late Adoption Sign-In Flow Reorder: Reorders the onboarding journey so sign-in occurs after waiting for generation right before final home introduction, ensuring momentum. (why: Sign-in during early steps causes drop-offs and friction; moving sign_in right before home intro leverages commitment bias after waiting.)
1: [home, wait_info] Real-Time Desktop Setup & Sync Status Indicator: Displays live status badges and estimated completion time during the waiting screen to reassure users while pet assets compile. (why: The waiting screen (home step) has a high mean duration of 2336 seconds and 14.2% drop-off rate, leaving users wondering if the app froze.)
2: [finish, hint] Desktop Screen Tray & Control Guidance Hint: Adds interactive guidance callouts on home_intro showing where the tray icon lives and how to bring the pet to focus. (why: Support emails report pets not showing up on desktop (3 emails) and confusion over how to control/hide pets (3 emails).)
3: [adoption, layout] Compact Grid Layout for Pick Friend Screen: Changes the pick_friend screen layout to compact to fit all starter pets and options on screen without scrolling. (why: The adoption step has a low conversion rate of 67.3% and median time of 89s; improving visual layout reduces choice fatigue.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Tray Notification Prompt on Waiting Screen: Adds a notification toggle and reminder on the waiting screen to alert users via system tray when pet generation finishes. (why: The median wait time is 201s with a mean of 2336s. Notifying users when ready keeps them engaged even if they switch windows.)

scores.note: Sign-in already converts well at 90.3%; reordering flow requires non-trivial app release.
Addresses long wait duration (mean 2336s) on home step to reduce perceived drop-off.
Strongly supported by multiple user support emails regarding tray visibility and controls.
Targets the largest single drop-off point in the funnel (adoption step at 67.3%).
Helps re-engage users during the long median (201s) and mean wait times on home step.
